scope: PUB.02 maintainer-authorized public repository snapshot derived from accepted local v0.4.0; source-specific data clearance is not inferred

source_checklist.extraction: visual inspection of rendered single scanned page

items.question: 数据来源是否全部列出并公开可得？
items.rationale: Source tables are supplied. Original legacy knot source inputs and encoder representation archives have no complete verified public retrieval route in this delivery.
items.next_action: Recover or document the historical knot input snapshot and publish an approved representation acquisition route.

items.question: 外部数据库是否提供访问日期或版本号？
items.rationale: Supplemental data carry source and export fingerprints. The original legacy KnotProt snapshot and complete per-query UniProt release information remain unresolved.
items.next_action: Recover original snapshots or create separately reviewed data versions from versioned cleared inputs.

items.question: 是否报告或处理来源数据的潜在偏差？
items.rationale: Sampling, label coverage, PU semantics and retrospective scope are described; this is disclosure rather than elimination of bias.

items.question: 是否充分描述数据清洗步骤或提供流水线？
items.rationale: Portable exporters and accepted supplemental protocols are included. The missing original legacy label inputs prevent a complete raw-source-to-label rebuild for every task.
items.next_action: Restore the missing lineage or publish a new separately reviewed annotation build without overwriting the frozen reference.

items.question: 是否呈现被移除来源数据的数量？
items.rationale: Task eligibility, unknown positions and selected-label denominators are recorded by task and data bundle.

items.question: 是否标识多来源合并并处理潜在问题？
items.rationale: Exact-sequence IDs, source references, coordinate mappings and differing cross-record labels are retained and checked.

items.question: 是否明确数据特征表示并提供实现？
items.rationale: Encoder revision, layer selection, pooling, residue coordinates and frozen feature protocols are explicit.

items.question: 是否提供标准特征集对照？
items.rationale: Scored pooled tasks include length/composition baselines; disorder reference includes amino-acid/local-context features on matching samples and folds.

items.question: 模型实现是否支持新数据训练与测试？
items.rationale: The software fits readers and scores new model representations on the frozen benchmark samples. The residue task is pinned to its accepted data manifest; arbitrary qualified new biological batches are not supported by a general training/test interface.
items.next_action: Define a versioned new-batch protocol, validate biological independence and historical use, and implement an explicit generic new-sample training/test interface before answering Yes.

items.question: 是否提供简单或平凡模型基线？
items.rationale: The pooled tasks provide length, composition, nearest and training-prior arms. The residue task provides a traditional local-context linear baseline.

items.question: 是否提供当前先进方法对照？
items.rationale: No matched external state-of-the-art comparator is included. ESM-2 and traditional diagnostic arms do not establish such a comparison.
items.next_action: Specify and run compatible external methods on the same qualified samples and frozen evaluation protocol in a later reviewed version.

items.question: 是否明确训练、调参和最终评价集合？
items.rationale: Frozen outer test and inner validation roles are explicit. Reader preprocessing and hyperparameter selection use the current training and inner-validation partitions.

items.question: 是否描述划分方法及其真实应用相容性？
items.rationale: Registered binding-group development evaluation and its application limits are described. No prospective independence is inferred.

items.question: 划分是否避免数据泄漏和相关样本跨集合？
items.rationale: Registered-group split and exact-sequence checks pass, but they do not certify a complete biological independence graph; historical use and 37 unresolved PDB-key gaps remain.
items.next_action: Complete graph coverage and historical-use audit before qualifying a genuinely independent prospective batch.

items.question: 代码或工作流是否在公共仓库可得？
items.rationale: The software is hosted in https://github.com/wyqmath/ConformEval; the repository Git commit identifies its exact version. This answer applies to code publication, not source-specific data permissions.

items.question: 是否提供复现论文发现的脚本？
items.rationale: All three archived prediction tasks can be rescored locally. Full raw-source and encoder-inference reproduction still needs external inputs; complete reader refitting is not the delivery validation.
items.next_action: Provide approved source snapshots, external representation acquisition and separately verify complete inference/refitting before asserting full computational reproduction.

items.question: 是否明确工作中使用的软件依赖版本？
items.rationale: The reference computation records actual versions, and the clean local scoring environment is recorded separately.
